claim: Fargate can launch up to 20 on-demand ECS tasks or EKS pods per second (sustained rate) in most Regions. In the Regions the table lists, and in Regions introduced after May 20, 2025, the maximum is 5 on-demand ECS tasks or EKS pods per second. The quota is adjustable.
question: How many on-demand Fargate ECS tasks or EKS pods can an account launch per second (sustained rate)?

values.display: 20 on-demand ECS tasks or EKS pods per second
5 on-demand ECS tasks or EKS pods per second
